==Description==
The Raptor is a swift, bipedal predator found across the desert and geothermal biomes. Built for speed and endurance, it uses powerful legs and curved talons to bring down prey with precision strikes. Despite its size, it moves with surprising agility, making it one of the deadliest hunters on Icarus.
==Lore==
Originally bred as a terraforming control species to manage invasive herbivores, the Raptor adapted rapidly to the planet's extremes. Desert variants developed lighter hides and heat-resistant scales, while geothermal strains evolved thicker skin and increased aggression. Prospectors have since discovered ways to tame and ride them-at considerable risk.

==Breeding==
{{PAGENAMEE}} can be bred using Raptor Fertility Serum crafted at the ranching station with 20 {{Item icon|Raw Meat}} and 3{{Item icon|Condensed Enzymes}} or 10 {{Item icon|Raw Meat}} and 5 {{Item icon|Exotics|exotics.}} Players can inject the males with the fertility serum to fertilize nearby females as long as they are well fed and cared for.
